rename.to: Script elements in template files should be innert

body: Related, as it allows to clone templates via `element.innerHTML` which does not trigger script elements: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/3364
I think we should just remove `<script>` tags in compilation. (Optionally move them into HEAD if that is want.)
I would vote for removing those tags altogether as I don't think we want to act as a "poor's man" loader via templates. Will send a first-shot PR so we can discuss.
